title: Host reconnect to the collab relay drops guests when the relay refuses it
instruction: When a collab host reconnects after a drop, the client resets the room and drains its send queue as soon as the socket opens. The relay refuses a duplicate host a moment later, so the guest list is lost and the queued backlog goes into a socket that is already doomed. Hold the reconnect open as provisional until the relay has had a chance to refuse it. If the relay accepts it, reset the room before any frame is dispatched.
acceptance_criteria: A refused reconnect leaves the room state and the send queue untouched.
The first relay message confirms the reconnect and the room reset happens before that message is dispatched.
relay-client exports HOST_RECLAIM_CONFIRM_MS, the time in milliseconds that a reclaim stays provisional.
